requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: I realise my background is in management engineering rather than the domain you would typically look for

requirements.note: Degree is Management Engineering, not electrical engineering/physics/applied mathematics; the candidate herself notes the mismatch. Adjacency/equivalence is a judgement call for the recruiter.

requirements.name: Team-lead experience
requirements.note: CV mentions managing the interface between engineering and operations teams, which is coordination rather than a stated leadership title over people.

lines.quote: Finnish citizen, employed under standard Finnish contract terms
I am based in Oulu, so there are no practical obstacles on the logistics side.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real timing constraints, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing Python code to production or engineering standards, such as code that is tested, maintained, or used by others, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or calibration of RF front ends, if any?
